title: AutoToM: Scaling Model-based Mental Inference via Automated Agent Modeling
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing an automated agent modeling method for mental inference, particularly Theory of Mind. While Theory of Mind can be related to social cognition, the paper does not explicitly deal with or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as a primary component. It aims to infer mental states like goals, beliefs, and desires, rather than evaluating or benchmarking ethical frameworks or religious beliefs.
